t: Pro-torque handle with 3 grip zones for comfort and control. Sand-blasted tips provide increased traction on screws, reducing slipping and effort required. Black phosphate-coated for durability and corrosion protection. Colour-coded handles with identification rings.
b: Contents: 3 x slotted (SL3.5 x 75, SL4 x 100 and SL5.5 x 150mm), 2 x PH (PH1 x 100 and PH2 x 125mm) and 1 x PZ (PZ2 x 125mm).
